description.value: The Coach Light Motel & RV Park sits on Highway 16 about one hour west of Prince George in Vanderhoof, serving travellers crossing through BC's Central Interior. It offers two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes and self check-in via passcode, making it well-suited for independent travellers arriving at odd hours. The property also has full RV hook-ups and spacious parking designed for large vehicles, giving touring cyclists ample room to maneuver with trailers.
